scope: Operationalization of the 42 issues from the previous 1000-match / evaluation / architecture / draw / PIT / engineering discussion. This registry is an engineering acceptance checklist, not a verbatim transcript.

items.evidence: v6_1x2_neutral_fixed1000_v6131_status.json: all_17_domains_present=true; market membership no longer controls benchmark
